contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Scar Excision

Transform Visible Scars Into Smoother, Refined Skin

Overview

Scar Excision is a minor surgical procedure designed to improve the appearance of prominent, widened, raised, or irregular scars.

Scars can develop following injuries, surgeries, burns, acne, or other skin conditions and may affect both appearance and confidence. The procedure involves carefully removing the existing scar tissue and repositioning the skin to create a finer, less noticeable scar. Treatment plans are customized according to the scar's size, location, and characteristics, with the goal of achieving smoother skin texture and improved cosmetic outcomes while maintaining natural skin contours.

Key benefits

  • Creates finer and smoother scar lines
  • Enhances skin texture and contour
  • Customized treatment for individual scars
  • Can improve functional skin movement
  • Long-lasting aesthetic improvement
  • Boosts confidence and self-image

Who should opt

  • Individuals with prominent surgical scars
  • People with widened or irregular scars
  • Patients seeking cosmetic scar improvement
  • Those with scars affecting confidence

The Procedure

01

Detailed scar evaluation and treatment planning

02

Local anesthesia for maximum comfort

03

Precise removal of existing scar tissue

04

Careful closure to create a finer scar

05

Follow-up care and scar management guidance
